exposure: neonatal adiposity (fat mass at day 2 and 2 months)
outcome: atopic dermatitis (AD) at 6 and 12 months of age
cohort: The study included 1537 infants participating in the Cork BASELINE birth cohort study.
finding: Neonatal adiposity (fat mass of the 80th percentile or greater at day 2) and maternal atopy were significant risk factors for atopic dermatitis at 6 and 12 months of age.
